svg.text: Cumulative daily RankIC over the test period
Running sum of the seed-mean daily RankIC; a steady slope means the edge is not concentrated in a few days
Best neural baseline = highest table RankIC among the six neural baselines in that fold; untuned, 3 seeds. MAGNET 10 seeds; [24] deterministic.
